title: Herman K Probable NDE 13087
content: After the first surgery, my soul was leaving the body and I could see the stars. A manifestation in human form came and pointed me back earth. My soul returned to my body. My wife said that's when I probably began to get better. They replaced my aorta and put in a new heart valve. I woke up about a week later and slowly began to recover. I still had physical issues afterwards. So, they did a second surgery and found many blood clots under my heart. I had trouble in recovery. I felt my soul leaving my body again. I could hear my wife crying in the background. I woke up later and was still in recovery. I was in the hospital from April 19th until the end of June. As time goes by, things begin to get hazy. I'm a believer in God now and all of his disciples. I believe I am a better person as well. After 4 years of disability, I am back to work now full-time. I continue to get new medical conditions to worry about, but try to keep life as normal as possible. God bless you all. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: April 2019 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Aorta aneurysm, heart valve malfunction. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I was totally aware what was happening. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? During the first experience. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. Unaware of time relevance Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Was aware of everything Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. No noise, completely quiet except the manifestation pointing me back to earth Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place. Seeing the stars, manifestation, and my soul. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Peace and quiet Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others. More relaxed in real world Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Protestant At time non practicing catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No Believe in God and his messengers. What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated After death experience. I got involved in different religions; none which met my standards. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Believe in God not disciples Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Believe in life after death and God Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Human Male in a brown robe with rope to keep it tied close Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes Believe in soul life after death after seeing manifestation During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes I am calmer and more peaceful During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Uncertain. The manifestation pointed me back to earth. Now, I believe the soul lives on after death Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life. Calmer and more understanding After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience less accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. As time goes by events slowly fade away. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Just the manifestation pointing my soul back to earth Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes With family first. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Uncertain Probably some but did not believe it What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. Wife said that's when I told her the manifestation pointed me back; that's when all my hospital machines started to work. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. Still in my memory At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Reduce descriptions needed after answering question oz4strx_nde

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Soul leaving body; could see the stars. Later, during second surgery recovery, felt soul leaving again and could hear wife crying in the background.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described 'peace and quiet' and 'incredible peace or pleasantness.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'manifestation in human form' / 'Human Male in a brown robe with rope to keep it tied close' who pointed him back to earth.

environment.environment_other_detail: Seeing the stars; described as 'some unfamiliar and strange place.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: A robed male manifestation 'pointed me back earth' and his soul returned to his body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Aorta aneurysm and heart valve malfunction; first surgery to replace aorta and put in a new heart valve; second surgery found many blood clots under the heart.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: Christian-Protestant; at time: non-practicing Catholic. Now: 'Unaffiliated - Nothing in particular - Religious unaffiliated.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Seeing stars; robed male manifestation pointed him back to earth; later second episode included hearing wife crying while feeling soul leaving again.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like separation with perception of stars and a manifestation directing return; no tunnel, no light, no boundary, no life review.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Felt soul leaving body during first surgery recovery and again during second surgery recovery.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reported 'Did you see any beings in your experience? No' but elsewhere described encountering a definite being/presence: 'Human Male in a brown robe with rope to keep it tied close' who pointed him back to earth.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “After the first surgery, my soul was leaving the body and I could see the stars.” “A manifestation in human form came and pointed me back earth.” “No noise, completely quiet except the manifestation pointing me back to earth.”
